title: Great way to see two major pieces of Seville history
text: Very informative tour of two amazing buildings. The architecture and decoration in both is beautiful. The climb up the bell tower is worth it too.
author: Jane_W

title: Great guided tour
text: Louis did an excellent job with this tour. He is very knowledgeable about Alcazar, the cathedral and the tower. What we liked also is he used a microphone so we could hear him also we were given the chance to explore on our own and sit down if we wanted. My husband was having back problems so this was very helpful. Good tour and good guide. Thanks Louis 👏👏
author: Cindy_D

title: Sevilla Historical Sites Centro with guide Guadalupe
text: If you have Guadalupe the guide, you will hear lots of super interesting historical facts and anecdotes. She lead us to many spots in these 3 sites and had great stories about them all. She also answered my many questions with even more interesting anecdotes. I enjoyed the tour very much and I thought it was good value for the cost.
author: Laura_H

title: Superb tour
text: Guylaine is a fantastic guide who knows her history with great anecdotes! Thank you!!
author: alinetE747OQ

title: The heart of Seville
text: Beautiful tour, presented impeccably by our guide Patrizia, who proved to be prepared, competent, and passionate.  Just the right duration and the tour was done without rushing. Recommended.
author: carlapA3586PO

title: Very interesting especially the gardens
text: The Alcazar gardens are imaginitively laid out and beautiful.  Fabulous carvings inside the palace.  Dont miss
author: 679DianaL

title: Irene our tour guide was outstanding
text: Irene our guide was outstanding with knowledge and enthusiasm.  The tour was well structured and a good pace to take in the details.
author: Huzz1234

title: Ask for Irene
text: The tour company made us feel vrry reassured by communicating days in advance of the tour.  Irene was our guide. She was very knowledgeable with a great personality to match.  I would recommend this your to anyone visiting Seville
author: arlyn_l

title: Exciting visit
text: Fantastic and fun visit; our guide Ghizlane gave us a nice and informative immersive experience.
author: pascalpJ1409SC

title: Interesting tour of...
text: Interesting tour of church and royal palace. Tour guide took her time to explain the history behind both attractions
